title: Quant profile lifecycle coordinator: ephemeral snapshots, accuracy gates, and ACL flows
creator: Riya Patel
description:
Goal: Build a coordinator service and Console UX that orchestrates calibration run snapshots, enforces accuracy validation gates for FP8/INT8 profiles, and applies tenant-aware retention/ACL policies. This ticket scopes the orchestration behaviour (snapshotting, TTL/pruning, promotion to immutable artifacts), the accuracy validation contract for automated gating, and the RBAC surface in Console for multi-tenant deployments.

Background: Teams are running calibration sweeps (FP8/INT8) at scale. Critical gaps: inconsistent snapshot naming/visibility, unclear lifecycle for ephemeral calibration outputs, accidental cross-tenant access during debug, and absence of a deterministic accuracy gate to block unsafe promotions. We need an end-to-end model: run -> ephemeral snapshot -> validation -> promote/export -> TTL-based prune with audit records.

Success criteria:
- Coordinator creates predictable, timestamped ephemeral snapshots per run and stores provenance metadata (model hash, dataset id, hyperparams) visible in Console.
- Automated accuracy gate compares baseline metrics to quantized candidate; failing candidates are flagged and cannot be promoted. Gate policies are pluggable (absolute threshold, relative delta, percentile).
- Promotion workflow creates immutable artifact with explicit ACLs (team, project, org) and retention tier (ephemeral 7d -> archive 365d).
- Console surfaces snapshot lifecycle, manual override flows, and a clear audit trail with links to eval dashboards and PR artifacts.

Non-goals: Full data-masking of calibration traces (handled by separate privacy project). Offline private deployment packaging (Private-onprem) is out of scope for initial MVP but hooks must exist.

Key UX flows to design in Console:
- Run detail page: snapshot list, current validation state, link to evaluation diff, buttons for promote/export/delete snapshot (subject to ACL).
- Global retention policy page: default TTLs per workspace + per-run override with approval flow.
- Access matrix editor for snapshots/artifacts: owner/team/org roles and audit log viewer.

Dependencies & integrations:
- Eval service (metrics carrier): required for accuracy comparisons and gating.
- Artifact store (S3/GCS): object lifecycle rules for TTL enforcement.
- Authz service: tenant-aware ACL checks and cross-tenant export controls.
- Console: UI surfaces and API proxies.

Trade-offs considered:
- Synchronous gating vs async: synchronous gating blocks the run end-to-end but provides immediate guardrails. We opt for an async gating job that marks snapshots and prevents promotion until check passes to avoid blocking long-running sweeps; a synchronous option is planned for small datasets.
- Ephemeral TTL defaults: shorter TTL reduces storage cost but increases re-run frequency. Default: 7 days ephemeral, 90 days cold, 365 days archive for promoted artifacts.
- Promotion permissions: conservative default (team leads only) but allow workspace-level policy override with audit scope.

Related docs and artifacts:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/quant-profile-lifecycle
- Eval dashboard prototype: https://dash.redwood.ai/eval/calibration-gate-proto
- Design sketches: Drive/Redwood/Design/quant-artifact-lifecycle.pdf
- API proposal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4238

Implementation phases:
1) Coordinator MVP (snapshot metadata, TTL lifecycle hooks, basic ACLs) + Console run page snapshot list.
2) Integrate Eval gating job with pluggable policies + gating status in Console.
3) Promote/export flow + immutable artifact creation + retention tiers + audit trails.
4) Admin UI for retention policy and ACL editor + canary rollout to Dedicated tenants.

Rollout plan:
- Internal dogfood (infra team) for 2 weeks -> gather failure modes and performance numbers.
- Beta with 3 early customers on Dedicated for 30 days with opt-in promotion.
- GA once audit and retention guarantees validated and SLOs achieved.
comments: 2025-01-12 -- PM review: clarified promotion ACL should not allow cross-tenant exports without explicit approval. Added approval step requirement and link to compliance checklist.

2025-01-18 -- Eng sync: runtime team prefers async gating to avoid head-of-line blocking; agreed to implement fast-path synchronous gate for <=10k tokens datasets. Action: ENG-24017 to add fast-path hook.
2025-01-22 -- Design feedback: snapshot list should show accuracy delta, dataset sample size, and top failing prompt examples. UX task DES-7719 created for the component.
2025-01-29 -- Security review kickoff: initial review flagged need for export auditing on artifacts and signed attestation on promotions. Added security_review_required=true on ticket.
2025-02-03 -- Alpha deployment: coordinator MVP deployed to staging. Snapshot naming collisions observed when parallel runs share run-name; patch submitted in PR #4238 to include run-id suffix.
notes: Staging telemetry shows average snapshot creation latency 150ms; eviction job currently scans object prefixes and is CPU-heavy. Investigate prefix batching or object tags for more efficient TTL enforcement. Also confirm cost model for storing ephemeral snapshots vs re-run costs (finance/infra calibration).
